list_operations.description: List the eight career workflows and their skills; no external actions.

plan_workflow.description: Get a scoped workflow and required shared records before working.

read_record.description: Read complete allowlisted ledger text with its hash; no arbitrary filesystem access.

find_application.description: List/filter paged vacancy history by stage or optional company/role/URL/posting text. Read complete matching records before acting.

get_approved_answer.description: Retrieve sourced answer sections; preserve their attribution and limits.

check_duplicate.description: Check exact vacancy history and outstanding company reservations. Read returned company records for limits.

start_run.description: Start a logged bounded workflow. This records user intent, not a permission grant.

get_run.description: Read compact run and paged submission attempts for recovery; use list_events(run_id) for history.

list_events.description: Find processed action IDs across runs or read recent audit events before repeating work.

finish_run.description: Finish with a concise digest and evidence; unresolved submissions cannot be completed.

record_event.description: Log a verified mail/archive/reply/booking/knowledge event and optionally update a canonical vacancy. Deduplicate with source ID.

update_application.description: Update the canonical tracking block with a dated event, evidence and automatic pipeline rebuild.

create_application.description: Record a newly discovered vacancy as saved with attributed fit evidence.

save_receipt.description: Preserve exact receipt bytes in private content-addressed storage.

prepare_packet.description: Freeze the exact CV PDF and answers/message, vacancy identity and source revision before reserving.

reserve_submission.description: Atomically reserve a vacancy and company for a bounded non-dry apply run; never expires uncertain attempts.

begin_submission.description: Mark one attempt submitting immediately before the external Submit. A crash now requires outcome reconciliation.

finish_submission.description: Save confirmed/unknown/negative outcome and advance the record only with evidence. Unknown stays blocked.

cancel_reservation.description: Cancel only a reservation that never began external submission.

reconcile_tracker.description: Report legacy/uncertain records, stale pipeline and unfinished runs; changes need evidence.

rebuild_pipeline.description: Recover pending local record writes and regenerate the pipeline under the shared lock.

bootstrap.description: Start here: one read-only call returns settings, task routing, recovery summary, missing capabilities and CLI fallback.

get_packet.description: Read hash-verified frozen artifact paths and packet metadata by ID.

inspect_tools.description: Discover compact tool descriptions, or fetch exact schemas for up to 10 named tools. Use deferred local tools through query_batch/execute_batch.

prepare_application.description: Freeze and reserve one application with one call. Does not begin or submit; begin_submission remains a separate one-shot boundary.

plan_adapter.description: Build one provider-neutral board-sync or portal-recovery plan. Pure plan; driver uses its own UI/API and returns verified observations.

record_adapter_result.description: Record one evidence-backed live adapter result. Verified stage/note must match a current plan; failure codes feed bounded recovery guidance.

query_batch.description: Batch up to 20 read-only calls. Chain exact {$ref:"step.data.field"} values from prior successful steps. Return per-step envelopes; no code execution.

execute_batch.description: Execute up to 20 ordered local steps, committing each separately. Stops on first error; earlier successes remain durable. No begin_submission or nested batches. Chain exact {$ref:"step.data.field"} values from prior successful steps. Return per-step envelopes; no code execution.

search_workspace.description: Search the disposable workspace index for sourced evidence, approved answers, application records and coaching. Results carry source paths, hashes and kinds; read full source records before using claims. This derived search never controls duplicate or submission decisions.

review_queue.description: Page recorded unknown/reserved submissions, prepared roles, interviews, pending intake reviews and supplied mail requiring replies or attribution review. Unknown/ambiguous mail stays visible; reads at most 100 unarchived notes and reports note_reviews_complete. No live inbox scan or automatic archive.

mail_observations_path.description: Bounded JSON file (<=1 MiB): {observed_at?: string|null, items: [{id?: string, needs_reply?: boolean|null, needs_review?: boolean, attribution?: string, subject?: string, company?: string, thread_url?: string, summary?: string, observed_at?: string, request_message_ids?: string[], latest_message_id?: string}]}. messages may replace items; workflow_check mail data may supply needs_attention instead of needs_reply. Missing/null request state or non-exact attribution stays in the queue. Resolved exact observations may be omitted. This file is supplied evidence, not a live inbox scan.

preview_packet.description: Preview frozen and current source hashes, packet changes and linked attempts. This is read-only and never begins a submission or grants authority; source changes are reported rather than silently refreshed.

intake_note.description: Preserve exact supplied notes or transcript text with explicit provenance. Originals remain immutable; this does not infer facts, update a CV or execute proposed next steps.

propose_note.description: Save a separate proposal with exact source hashes and line citations. Summaries, additions and next steps remain proposed; citations prove source freshness and location, not semantic truth.

review_note.description: Read original provenance, proposals, accepted review views and source freshness. Request include_original only when the full original text is needed.

accept_note.description: Record explicitly selected proposal items and attributed approval in a derived review view. Requires the reviewed proposal hash; originals, career facts, CVs and external actions remain separate.

archive_note.description: Archive local intake review metadata after an explicit reason and evidence. All original notes, proposals and accepted review artifacts remain retained.

list_notes.description: List compact source-kind, freshness and archive metadata for private intake notes; load exact originals and proposals only as needed.

context_pack.description: Build one bounded, cited evidence pack for a task using exact paths, company/project scope and an optional period. Carries source hashes, line anchors, supplied date/source-kind metadata and explicit gaps; no model calls, inferred dates, generated interpretation or action authority. Read full referenced sources when needed.

project.description: Project scope: an exact context/projects/*.md or *.json path seeds that source and linked notes independently of query hits; a supplied project name is searched independently of query.

workflow_check.description: Check 1–20 typed host observations using the inline child schemas: scan coverage, canonical mail identity and latest requests, scoped dated answers, and form readback/upload evidence. No mail action, submission or canonical changes.

request_message_ids.description: Observed request-bearing message IDs, excluding receipts; omit/null means request evidence is incomplete.

latest_message_id.description: Latest fully observed thread message ID; must belong to message_ids. Missing latest evidence remains reviewable.

expected_name.description: Expected submitted filename if the frozen artifact is deliberately presented under a different name; otherwise the source basename is checked.

completeness_confirmed.description: Affirmative host evidence that all form fields and uploads were observed. Empty observations cannot be ready without true; false always blocks readiness.
